"""Account successful and failed owners and actual V160 scientific calls."""
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1')
training=read(root/'status-v2.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json')
assert training['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status']=='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
assert set(post['completed'])=={'checkpoint-validation','review','scores','metric-audit','render'}
assert all(v['returncode']==0 for v in post['completed'].values())
original=read(root/'status-v1.json');oldpost=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert original['status']==oldpost['status']=='failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry'
owners=[('original-controller',original['owner'])]
owners += [(name,read(root/f'{name}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for name in ['parity','prefix','smoke']]
owners += [('original-cache-failed',read(root/'cache-failure-v1.json')['owner']),('original-review-queue',oldpost['owner']),
    ('continuation-controller',training['owner']),('continuation-cache',read(root/'cache-result-v2.json')['owner']),
    ('train',read(root/'train-result-v1.json')['owner']),('review-controller',post['owner'])]
owners += [(stage,item['owner']) for stage,item in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners)==len({(x['pid'],x['created']) for _,x in owners})==15
records=[]
for stage,owner in owners:
    assert not live(owner),(stage,owner)
    try:
        p=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        terminal='PID-reused-original-terminal' if abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])>=.01 else p.status()
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:terminal='absent'
    records.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':terminal})
cache=read(root/'cache-result-v2.json');prefix=read(root/'prefix-result-v1.json');failure=read(root/'cache-failure-v1.json')
assert cache['counts']=={'parent_root':977,'DINO':977} and cache['adopted_parent_batches']==23
assert prefix['counts']=={'parent_root':10,'DINO':10} and failure['progress']['counts']=={'parent_root':13,'DINO':13}
oldrows=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'cache-trace-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
newrows=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'cache-trace-v2.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(oldrows)==13 and len(newrows)==977
assert cache['batches']==prefix['batches']+oldrows+newrows
assert [x['step'] for x in cache['batches']]==list(range(1,1001))
for revision,steps in [(1,list(range(11,24))),(2,list(range(24,1001)))]:
    forward=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/f'cache-forward-events-v{revision}.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [x['step'] for x in forward]==steps
    assert forward[-1]['returned_forwards']=={'parent_root':len(steps),'DINO':len(steps)}
sensor_unique={k:sum(r['metadata']['sensor']['sampler_calls'][k] for r in cache['batches']) for k in ['Poisson','Gaussian']}
assert sensor_unique=={'Poisson':3309,'Gaussian':1927}
actual_sensor={'Poisson':sensor_unique['Poisson']+3,'Gaussian':sensor_unique['Gaussian']+1}
assert actual_sensor=={'Poisson':3312,'Gaussian':1928}
for key in ['Poisson','Gaussian']:
    assert cache['source_counts'][key]==sum(r['metadata']['actual_sampler_calls'][f'sensor_{key}'] for r in newrows)
procedural=sum(r['metadata']['actual_sampler_calls']['procedural_Gaussian'] for r in newrows)
assert procedural==cache['source_counts']['procedural_Gaussian']
legacy_procedural=sum(c['source']['present_recipe']['kind']=='bandlimited' for r in cache['batches'][:23]
    if r['metadata']['domain']=='weak' for c in r['metadata']['cases'][0::2])
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');assert review['component_forwards']==review['new_prediction_arrays']==3288
paths=set()
for binding in review['collections'].values():
    c=read(binding['path']);assert c['component_forwards']==822
    forward=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
    observations=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [r['returned_forwards'] for r in forward]==list(range(1,823))
    assert observations==c['observations'] and len(observations)==822
    for row in observations:
        p=Path(row['prediction']['path']);assert p.is_relative_to('/mnt/external')
        assert str(p) not in paths;paths.add(str(p))
assert len(paths)==3288
head_calls=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json')['component_forward_evaluations']
head_calls+=sum(read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())
head_calls+=sum(read(root/'train-result-v1.json')['counts'].values())+review['component_forwards']
assert head_calls==5364
excluded={os.getpid()}|{p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()};matching=[]
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
    if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:continue
    if any(t==str(root) or t.startswith(str(root)+'/') for t in p.info['cmdline'] or []):matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching,matching
dest=root/'execution-completion-v1.json';assert not dest.exists()
save(dest,{'status':'all15-successful-and-failed-owners-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'recorded_owner_count':15,'owners':records,'live_matching_root_argv':matching,
    'actual_parent_root_calls':1000,'actual_DINO_backbone_calls':1000,'parent_images':4000,'DINO_images':4000,
    'head_calls':head_calls,'head_image_evaluations':11424,
    'unique_training_observations':4000,'actual_source_constructions_including_failed24':4004,
    'actual_sensor_sampler_API_calls':actual_sensor,'unique_cache_sensor_sampler_API_calls':sensor_unique,
    'procedural_Gaussian_API_calls_continuation_measured':procedural,
    'procedural_Gaussian_API_calls_legacy_derived_from_recipes':legacy_procedural,
    'procedural_Gaussian_API_calls_failed24':1,
    'scientific_cache_stage_failures':1,'full_training_restarts':0,'successful_parent_forwards_repeated':0,
    'new_prediction_arrays':3288,'review_root_calls':3288,'returned_forward_journal_entries':1000+3288,
    'training_completion':ref(root/'status-v2.json'),'postprocess_completion':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json'),
    'failure':ref(root/'cache-failure-v1.json'),'adoption':ref(root/'cache-adoption-v2.json'),
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'All scientific root/head/backbone calls exclude separate CPU regression tests. Original source24 failed only the accounting assertion after construction;no parent call or retained input. Explicit continuation adopted23 successful parent batches and constructed remaining977 once;first full training and all3288 review predictions completed once. Sensor API calls distinguish shared Poisson/read transport from procedural Gaussian texture draws. Executed cache receipt legacy prose990/adopt10 is superseded by actual977/adopt23 fields and these journals;frozen bytes preserved.'})
print('PASS all15 owners terminal;5364 head calls,1000 parent/DINO each;one accounted cache failure,zero successful-parent replays')
